parsed.name: 串口实验仪器
parsed.description: 一种通过串行端口与计算机交换文本命令和响应的通用实验室仪器或控制器。它通常用于接收控制指令、返回测量值或状态信息，并可进行端口发现、通信测试和设备识别。该类设备常见于各类实验室控制器、位移台控制器及其他基于串口通信的仪器。
parsed.description_en: A general laboratory instrument or controller that exchanges text commands and responses with a computer over a serial port. It is typically used to accept control commands, return measurements or status information, and support port discovery, communication testing, and device identification. Devices of this kind are common among lab controllers, stage controllers, and other serially connected instruments.
